## About
Local Plumbing & Sewer is a plumbing company on James St in Bensenville with a certified Master Plumber on staff. We do residential and commercial plumbing and sewer work for customers in the northwest suburbs, the Chicagoland area and surrounding areas.
Need your sewer line repaired? Is your water heater leaking, or did the cold weather freeze your water lines? Or maybe you just have a clogged drain. Give us a call and one of our trained plumbing technicians will be able to help you.
Customers tend to know Matt by name. Monica wrote that he made sure things were functional but aesthetic as well, even under the kitchen sink. We're rated 5 from 77 Google reviews.

## Services
- Water Heaters: Leaking water heater? We repair and replace them.
- Water Leak Detection: Finding the leak before it does more damage.
- Frozen Water Lines: When cold weather leaves your water lines frozen, we'll get the water moving again.
- RPZ Valve Testing: Testing, plus RPZ valve repair, replacement and installation.
- Sump Pumps: Sump pumps, ejector pumps and battery back up systems.
- Main Sewer Cleaning: Clearing the main line, plus floor, shower, tub, sink, laundry and kitchen drains.
- Sewer Line Camera Inspections: A camera down the line so you can see what's going on before any digging.
- Sewer Line Repair: Repair or full replacement of damaged sewer lines.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're based in Bensenville and work with customers from the northwest suburbs, the Chicagoland area and other surrounding areas.

Q: Do you stand behind your work?
A: Yes. We warranty our work.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Saturday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.
